en.bdb: Devoid of virtues, the stupid is arrogant

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੁਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਰੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਅਰੰਡੁ ਅਞਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: rukhaa(n) vich kurukh hai ara(n)dd an(j)aiee aap ganaae|

en.bdb: The worst possible among the trees is castor tree which undesrvedly makes itself noticed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਦਾ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੇਰੂਆਂ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pidhaa jiau pa(n)kherooaa(n) beh beh ddaalee bahut bafaae|

en.bdb: Pidd jiu, a very small among the birds goes an jumping from one branch to another and feels much inflated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੇਡ ਭਿਵਿੰਗਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਰਣਾਪੈ ਦਿਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhedd bhivi(n)gaa muh karai taranaapai dheh chaar valaae|

en.bdb: The sheep, too, during its brief... youth bleats loudly (proudly).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕਨ ਜਿਉਂ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਂਡਿ ਸਦਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: muh akhee nak kan jiau(n) i(n)dhreeaa(n) vich gaa(n)dd sadhaae|

en.bdb: Anus also feels proud of being called one of the organs like eye, ear, nose and mouth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੀਆ ਘਰਹੁ ਨਿਕਾਲੀਐ ਤਰਕਸੁ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਟੰਗਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: meeaa gharahu nikaaleeaai tarakas dharavaaje Ta(n)gavaae|

en.bdb: The husband even while kicked out of home by wife hangs his quiver at the door (to show his masculinity).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਾਣਸਾਂ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੈ ਆਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: moorakh a(n)dhar maanasaa(n) vin gun garab karai aalaae|

en.bdb: Similarly among the human beings, the stupid one devoid of all virtues feels proud of himself and persistently tries to get noticed.
In an assembly, he beholds only his ownself (and not the wisdom of others).
